world.name: Aethra
story: Long ago Aethra was a single land, warmed by the Aetherwell, the spring of living magic at its heart. Beneath the spring slept the Hollow, a hunger older than the stars. To keep it asleep, the Seven Wardens forged the Mystic Box and locked the Hollow inside.

A generation ago, a plague swept through the kingdom of Nocthaven. Malachar, the last of the Wardens, opened the Box in search of a cure. The Hollow breathed out, and the land cracked into the Shattered Realms in a single night that every child of Aethra now calls the Sundering.

The Box was never closed again. It drifts in the Riftheart, the crater where the Sundering began, and it calls champions from every realm, binding them into cards for the summoners it chooses. No one knows whether it is gathering an army to seal the Hollow again, or simply choosing who will be standing when the Hollow wakes.

chronicle.title: The Aetherwell
chronicle.text: Aethra is one land, warmed by the spring of living magic. Uriel stands at the Gate of Dawn, and the dragons drink from the Sunwell.

chronicle.title: The forging of the Box
chronicle.text: Seven Wardens forge the Mystic Box to lock away the Hollow. One of them walks out before it is finished, calling it a bad idea. Uriel keeps the key.

chronicle.title: The plague of Nocthaven
chronicle.text: A plague sweeps through Nocthaven. Malachar, the last Warden, searches every forbidden book for a cure, and every book points to the Box.

chronicle.title: The world breaks
chronicle.text: Malachar opens the Box. The Hollow breathes out and Aethra cracks into the Shattered Realms. Ignis swallows the Everfire, Leoric holds the cathedral doors, Valeria rides out while Aurelius holds the gate, Vaelora lifts the western hills into the sky, and a star falls into a cradle in Greenhollow.

chronicle.title: Betrayals and vows
chronicle.text: The volcano lords betray the dragon-queen of Cinderpeak, and Draemir does not fly south. Zarathor gives his shadow away to save his city. The Tonbo castle burns in Hoshigane.

chronicle.title: What was saved
chronicle.text: Cassius rebuilds the temple of Solmarr, Isolde founds the Tidewatch, Seraphiel opens the shelter of Ithrel and the steam cities of Cogsreach rise from the ruins.

chronicle.title: The calling
chronicle.text: The Box begins to call champions from every realm and bind them into cards for the summoners it chooses. You are one of them.

regions.name: The Riftheart
regions.description: A crater of floating stone and violet light where the Sundering began. The Mystic Box drifts at its center, humming. Nobody lives here; everyone who has seen it dreams about it afterward.
regions.whisper: On quiet nights the Box hums a lullaby. Grizelda says she taught it to the Wardens.

regions.name: Hrimvald
regions.description: Endless tundra, ice cliffs and a single mountain pass that connects the north to the rest of Aethra. The wind-wolves still howl here, and the knights of the pass answer them.
regions.whisper: The wind-wolves are howling south again. Boreas has started answering.

resonance.name: Frostgate Howl
resonance.description: The wind-wolves howl: every foe starts Slowed for 2 turns.

characters.name: Boreas
characters.title: The Wall of the Northern Gale

regions.name: The Zephyrine Isles
regions.epithet: Islands that float on the wind
regions.description: Fragments of land torn into the sky by the Sundering, now ruled by an empress who steers them with the wind. Dragons nest on their undersides, and waterfalls pour into the clouds.
regions.whisper: The isles drift a little closer to the Riftheart every year. The empress says it is the wind.

resonance.name: Tailwind
resonance.description: The isles' winds carry the team: +20% celerity.

regions.name: Nocthaven
regions.epithet: The kingdom that would not die
regions.description: The kingdom where the plague began and the Box was opened. Its graveyards stretch to the horizon, its libraries read their readers, and its nobles bargain with shadows to keep their thrones.
regions.whisper: A raven of violet fire has been seen perched on Malachar's window, and he has not chased it away.

resonance.name: Grave Chill
resonance.description: The cold of the crypts seeps in: every foe starts Weakened for 2 turns.

characters.name: Malachar
characters.title: The Warden Who Opened the Box

characters.name: Morwen
characters.title: The Widow of the Dead Forest

characters.name: Ravenna
characters.title: The Raven of the Last Rites

regions.name: The Skyspire
regions.description: A tower of cloud and marble that rises from the Riftheart's edge into the heavens. Angels, astrologers and star-hunters live on its terraces, watching the cracked sky for what falls through it.
regions.whisper: Elysia has stopped singing. The astrologers say the stars have started singing instead.

resonance.name: Starlit Ward
resonance.description: Starlight wraps the team in a shield worth 15% of max vitality.

characters.name: Elysia
characters.title: The Choir of the Silent Wind

characters.name: Lyra
characters.title: The Archer Who Shoots the Constellations

characters.name: Uriel
characters.title: The Spear of the First Dawn

regions.name: Greenhollow Vale
regions.description: Farms, meadows and sleepy villages that the Sundering somehow spared. At its edge lies the Mirewood swamp, and the vale's folk know better than to go there after dark.
regions.whisper: A candle burns every night in the window of an empty study, waiting for an astrologer to come home.

resonance.name: Hearth and Harvest
resonance.description: A taste of home: the team starts with Regen for 3 turns.

characters.name: Tobin
characters.title: The Farm Boy With a Big Sword

characters.name: Wren
characters.title: The Meadow Boy and His Slime

regions.name: The Sylvaran Wilds
regions.description: The oldest forest in Aethra, home of the elves, the moon flowers and the spirit beasts. Its trees remember the world before the Sundering and do not forgive those who forgot it.
regions.whisper: The roots beat like a second heart, and the girl the forest gave birth to can feel it.

resonance.name: Rootbound
resonance.description: The roots lend their strength: +12% vitality.

characters.name: Sylva
characters.title: The Voice of the Old Grove

regions.name: The Aurelian Dominion
regions.description: Golden cathedrals, sun temples and the knightly orders sworn to protect them. The Dominion survived the Sundering by holding its gates shut, and some of its knights still have not forgiven themselves for it.
regions.whisper: A golden knight visits the ruins of Ithrel every month, leaves alms at the door and never gives his name.

resonance.name: Lion's Oath
resonance.description: Shields locked like the old Order: +12% bulwark and resolve.

characters.name: Leoric
characters.title: The Lion of the Fallen Cathedral

characters.name: Aurelius
characters.title: The Paladin Who Kept the Gates

characters.name: Cassius
characters.title: The Hammer of the Mountain Temple

regions.name: The Hoshigane Isles
regions.description: Eastern islands of cherry blossoms, temple lanterns and sword clans. Their duels are poems, and their feuds last for generations.
regions.whisper: A fugitive of the shadow clan was seen saving the last dragonfly swordsman. Again.

resonance.name: First Petal
resonance.description: The first cut decides the duel: the team starts Empowered for 2 turns.

characters.name: Kage
characters.title: The Blue Flame in the Dark

regions.name: Spirehollow
regions.epithet: The city of a thousand rooftops
regions.description: A free city of spires and night markets built on the crossroads of every trade route. Everything is for sale here, including secrets, and especially loyalty.
regions.whisper: The guild's enforcer has been ordered to bring down the rooftop hunter. He keeps losing her trail. On purpose.

resonance.name: Rooftop Ambush
resonance.description: Strike from the shadows: every foe starts Exposed for 2 turns.

characters.name: Nyra
characters.title: The Claw of the Moonlit Roofs

regions.name: The Ironfang Highlands
regions.description: Rocky peaks and wind-scoured passes ruled by warrior clans, arenas and caravans. The earth here is restless and full of runes nobody remembers carving.
regions.whisper: The warlord who cannot die has died a fourth time. The clans are counting, and so is his son.

resonance.name: Clan Fury
resonance.description: The war drums of the clans: +15% might.

characters.name: Gorvane
characters.title: The Warlord Who Would Not Fall

regions.name: The Thalassar Coast
regions.description: A coast of tide-temples, sunken cities and harbor towns. The Sundering drowned half of it, and on quiet nights the bells of the sunken temples can still be heard beneath the waves.
regions.whisper: A puppet in Merrow sings hymns no one has sung since the temples drowned.

resonance.name: Tide Hymn
resonance.description: The drowned temples sing along: +15% arcana.

regions.name: Cinderpeak
regions.description: Volcanoes, lava falls and fortresses of black glass. The Everfire burns somewhere in its depths, and the dragons that once ruled here have not given up on returning.
regions.whisper: The stones under the volcano are singing a warning: the Everfire is about to change hands.

resonance.name: Everfire Spark
resonance.description: The mountain's flame burns in the team: +3 starting Aether.

regions.name: Cogsreach
regions.description: Cities of brass, steam and captured lightning, run by barons who grew rich selling machines to the realms rebuilding after the Sundering. Not everyone in Cogsreach got rich.
regions.whisper: The storm tower of Voltaris is failing, and only one archivist is holding it together.

resonance.name: Overclock
resonance.description: Gears spin up: +2 starting Aether and +10% celerity.

characters.name: Brina
characters.title: The Tinker of the Brass Workshop

omen.title: The Moonbloom
omen.text: The moon flowers bloom all at once for the first time since the Sundering. The old grove is singing.
